data.narrative: The student demonstrated outstanding iteration discipline while building the real-time activity feed, correctly identifying a structural dead-end in Round 1 and executing an immediate clean restart using Redis PubSub distributed channels. When faced with a simulated regression caused by context pollution, they resisted the sunk-cost trap and consolidated all architectural invariants into an unpolluted restart prompt, shipping a resilient WebSocket implementation within budget.
